name_reason: Already compliant: data_fd2_battle_ prefix (battle core table), descriptor names the owning state machine (summon_anim_variant_b_6slot) and reflects the data type/role (frame_counter_array). 'variant_b' and '6slot' are domain semantics (animation variant id, slot count), not Ghidra address residue; no hex suffix present. Accurately reflects purpose and int32[6] array type.
purpose: Per-slot frame counter (int32[6]) for the variant-B 6-slot summon-spell animation state machine fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_b_6slot (summon-spell tick dispatch entry +5 of 10).
logic_summary: Sole accessor fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_b_6slot. INIT state (state_code==0) seeds slot i with -2*i (0,-2,-4,..,-10), a staggered start. TICK states (2/5/8) increment each slot's counter, wrap it to 0 at frame==7 (when terminate_flag==0), and gate the per-slot blit on the signed visible range 0 <= counter < 6. Frame==0 triggers the 2-bucket chime SFX (slot 0 and slot 3). Counter reaching 2 sets the done flag (return value). Zero-init BSS, runtime-seeded each animation, not a const table.
element_semantics: One signed int32 per animation slot (6 slots). Negative during the staggered INIT delay (-2*i), counts up through the active window, wraps to 0 at frame 7. The signed 'counter >= 0 && counter < 6' test selects the visible/blitted frames; negative values are pre-start delay, >=6 are post-window.
